steps.title: Conventional first-time buyer
steps.text: From 3% down* on a primary residence for eligible buyers with stable income.

steps.title: FHA home loan
steps.text: From 3.5% down*, with more flexible credit and underwriting for qualifying borrowers.

steps.title: CHFA down payment assistance
steps.text: A grant or deferred second mortgage for eligible Colorado buyers.

steps.title: metroDPA
steps.text: Help with upfront costs for eligible Front Range buyers through a second mortgage.

self-employed-borrower.headline: Self-employed?
self-employed-borrower.headlineAccent: There's more than one way to qualify.
self-employed-borrower.intro: A plain-English guide to four loan programs that qualify you on your business activity, not your tax-return income. Written by Jorge Alba.
highlights: Bank statement and 1099-only loans, from 10% down*
Profit and loss and asset depletion options
What to prepare so your approval moves faster
self-employed-borrower.formNote: Download it instantly. Jorge will email you a copy and is happy to answer questions.
self-employed-borrower.insideIntro: The best option depends on how you earn, what documentation you have, and the funds you can use.

steps.title: Bank statement loan
steps.text: Qualify on 12 months of eligible deposits. From 10% down, 660+ credit*.

steps.title: 1099-only loan
steps.text: Use two years of 1099s instead of tax-return net income. From 10% down, 660+ credit*.

steps.title: Profit and loss loan
steps.text: Qualify with a reliable P&L statement. From 20% down, 660+ credit*.

steps.title: Asset depletion loan
steps.text: Turn eligible savings and investments into qualifying income. From 20% down, 680+ credit*.
